text:
alex: Hey team — opening this thread for a quick review. I'm planning a Terraform change to the GPU nodepool module to add: a small spot burst pool (for cheap short jobs), TTL-based spot node cleanup, and an instance-profile IAM tweak so nodes can read SSM params. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4822. Can people flag any obvious gotchas (taints/labels, rolling, secrets) before I ship?

maria: Quick q — are we creating a separate nodepool for the spot burst or doing mixed instances in the same pool? mixing can be simpler but might complicate autoscaler math.

alex: separate pool. Plan: tiny baseline of 0, burst up to 8 spot g5.xlarge, fallback to on-demand reserved pool if spot capacity not available. TTL cleaner will delete empty spot nodes after 5m of idle.

sam: sgtm. Two gotchas: 1) taints — make sure spot pool has a taint like `spot=true:PreferNoSchedule` (or NoSchedule if you want strict), and workloads must tolerate it. 2) Pod disruption when autoscaler drains — use graceful draining and PDBs for critical jobs.

tia: Also IAM: the instance profile change needs kms:Decrypt for the KMS key used for SSM and ssm:GetParameter for parameter paths. We had CI fail once because the launch template role couldn't read `/redwood/gpu/nodepool/ssh-key` at boot. Add tests in the module that render the policy.

alex: good call. I'm adding an `instance_profile_policy` var that attaches a minimal SSM/KMS policy. Example snippet I'm including in PR: ```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["ssm:GetParameter", "kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": ["arn:aws:ssm:us-west-2:123456:parameter/redwood/gpu/*", "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01"]
}
```

maria: For tfvars naming, can we keep `gpu_spot_pool_enabled`, `gpu_spot_pool_max`, and `gpu_spot_pool_ttl_seconds` namespaced under module? We've had confusion before where top-level vars collide with other node pools.

sam: Also FYI on AWS launch template — if you want capacity reservations (for reserved pool fallback) we used `capacity_reservation_specification` inside the launch template. Example: ```hcl
capacity_reservation_specification {
  capacity_reservation_preference = "open"
}
``` That lets you target a CR if you have one. But if we rely on reserved instances rather than CRs, it's fine to skip.

alex: We're not buying Capacity Reservations yet, just planned fallback to an on-demand reserved pool. The `capacity_reservation_specification` guidance is helpful if we change strategy later.

tia: For the TTL cleaner: instead of deleting nodes abruptly, consider cordon+drain + `kubectl delete node` after pods are evicted. Node termination handler helps if spot interruptions happen — but for our idle TTL, a small controller that checks GPU metrics and only drains if `idle_seconds > ttl` prevents killing jobs in flight.

maria: What about autoscaler config? If the spot pool min=0 and max=8, cluster-autoscaler needs `--expander=least-waste` and proper labels on nodegroups so it doesn't scale away reserved nodes. Also make sure scale-down delay tolerates GPU workloads (we use 10m scale-down-protection for GPU).

sam: Secret wiring: Bootstrapping script reads SSH keys from SSM and also mounts `/etc/redwood/credentials` with IAM role. Make sure your cloud-init doesn't log secrets to serial. We had a bug where `echo $SSM_PARAM` ended up in logs. Use `aws ssm get-parameter --with-decryption --name /redwood/.. | jq -r .Parameter.Value > /etc/...` with proper file perms.

alex: noted, will update cloud-init snippet and remove `echo` usage. Also will add a smoke check in the module tests that simulates an instance profile and asserts `ssm:GetParameter` is allowed.

infra-bot: CI build started for PR #4822 — plan check, tf validate, fmt. https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/4822/1

maria: one more: rolling strategy — do this in two ops: 1) create spot pool (min=0) and add taint/labels, 2) gradually switch workloads that are tolerant to prefer spot. Don't flip configs that would cause controller-manager to evict lots of pods in one shot.

sam: And add node label `redwood.gpu.type=g5` and `redwood.gpu.pool=spot-burst` so we can target podSelectors easily in job specs.

tia: LGTMs on the IAM snippet. Also add a note to the ops runbook about how to rotate the SSM key and update launch template version. We had a confusing incident where newer LT versions rolled without the right user-data.

alex: Thanks all — I'll split the PR into two commits per Maria's suggestion and add the IAM/test bits per Tia. Will ping when ready for final review. :thumbsup:
